---

**What**

A clear description of the feature.

**Why**

What problem it solves or what experience it improves.

**Not a cheat**

Confirm this feature changes only your local experience and does not give an
explicit advantage (gameplay automation, score manipulation, on-the-wire changes,
reading others' data).

**Approach (optional)**

A rough idea of how it could be implemented (core change, a plugin, an API
extension, ...).
